successCriteria.description: Employee interface is defined in src/modules/employee/employee.model.ts with all 13 fields: id, employeeNumber, firstName, lastName, email, managerId, department, hireDate, terminationDate, employmentStatus, createdAt, updatedAt, deletedAt — each with the correct TypeScript type as specified

IEmployeeRepository interface extends IBaseRepository<Employee> and declares four additional methods: findByEmployeeNumber(employeeNumber: string): Promise<Employee | null>, findByEmail(email: string): Promise<Employee | null>, findByManagerId(managerId: string): Promise<Employee[]>, findActive(): Promise<Employee[]>

EmployeeRepository class implements IEmployeeRepository using the pg pool from src/shared/db/connection.ts with parameterized SQL queries ($1, $2, etc.) for all methods — no string concatenation or template literals for query values
Jest unit tests in tests/unit/modules/employee/employee.repository.spec.ts cover findById, findByEmployeeNumber, findByEmail, create, and update with a mocked pg pool

constraints: All SQL queries in EmployeeRepository must use parameterized queries ($1, $2, ...) — no string concatenation or template literal interpolation of user-supplied values
Employee model must import EmploymentStatus from src/shared/types/index.ts (not redefine it)
IEmployeeRepository must extend IBaseRepository<Employee> — all five base methods (findById, findAll, create, update, delete) must be implemented in addition to the four employee-specific methods
EmployeeRepository must import pool from src/shared/db/connection.ts — no inline database connection creation
outOfScope: Employee service, controller, or routes — only the model and repository are in scope for this phase
Database migrations for the employees table — migrations are deferred to Phase 10

ambiguities.description: The findActive() method semantics: should it filter by employmentStatus = 'ACTIVE', or by deletedAt IS NULL, or both? The most natural reading given the field name is employmentStatus = 'ACTIVE', but the intent does not explicitly define the filter criteria.
options: Filter by deletedAt IS NULL only
Filter by both employmentStatus = 'ACTIVE' AND deletedAt IS NULL
